actual_reading: Read the complete current Statement, Facts and proof of every listed canonical carrier. No published source was edited. Source references are current raw-byte bindings, not claims of whole-closure re-audit.

hypothesis_checks.bumps: Euclidean nested-ball result applies in dimensions1 and2. Strict chart support margins permit restriction to half-space/quadrant charts and zero extension. Finite-cover normalization is proved locally, rather than applying a boundaryless partition theorem to corners. Compact-set manifold bumps are used only in the boundaryless interior.
hypothesis_checks.flow: Boundaryless fundamental-flow theorem supplies smooth local ambient chart flows and inverse slices. Boundary-tangent theorem is applied only after extending through transverse regular level ends, so the remaining boundary is precisely free faces and the field is tangent to the whole boundary near the compact slab. Compactness supplies a finite uniform restart time for the desired slab interval; global completeness is not assumed.
hypothesis_checks.partition_and_ODE_limits: The ordinary smooth-partition theorem does not itself state a corners version, so it is not cited as such. The Euclidean compact-ODE extension lemma is not treated as a global manifold/corner theorem; the actual finite-chart continuation proof is supplied locally.
